title: Super Coals
description: More Coals from Furnace in Minecraft
body:
![Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/QcS6WCxp/images/43878f898e9a3070f6eda66241ca412973fbe937.png)Tired of regular coal burning out in seconds? This mod completely changes the game.

Get ready to take your furnaces to the next level with 14 new types of coal and their 14 matching blocks, each one stronger and longer-lasting than the last. No more constantly checking your furnaces… now you can light them and forget about them.

What’s included?
14 unique coal variants
14 compact storage blocks for better efficiency
Custom achievements to show off your progress
Why do you need it?

It’s the mod if you want:

Fuel that actually lasts (from minutes to days or even months)
Less time managing furnaces, more time exploring
Stronger options for energy and automation

Turn something basic into something essential. Upgrade your survival, optimize your resources, and leave boring vanilla coal behind.
